account: Today has mostly appeared routine: office business, a bridge inspection report, accounts review, and tea with my neighbour. The builder reported no confirmed defects at the bridge, landing, or warehouse approach. I personally counted 128 emeralds in the treasury, but outstanding commitments remain unverified. The secretary says no accounts ledger or commitments register has been located and asked to search the great hall table chests. That gap concerns me, but it is not evidence of wrongdoing. My attempted permission and follow-up questions were not heard, so I cannot assume the secretary received them. Freight reported an empty warehouse and no confirmed orders, offering transport quotations if quantities and destinations are supplied. The innkeeper apparently wants confirmed visitor numbers; I do not yet know for what occasion or date. This could be ordinary planning for guests and deliveries, rather than anything secret. My neighbour reported no unusual riverside activity, and the secretary has no other confirmed concerns or incoming letters. I still feel I may be missing something, but I have seen no evidence of a hidden gathering or coordinated scheme. I need to clarify the innkeeper's request and locate the financial records without treating uncertainty as proof.
